redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage nr-block` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 3 of 6 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (HEAD's own tests on HEAD's code failing only the unknown-stage check for `nr-block`, which the task's test files add - the stage is new at HEAD), each passing with the working tree's implementation - nr1 (house FAIL), nr3 (house FAIL), nr3b (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 2/6 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: pending_still_applies now drops ANY parked no-<role>-return decision through one rule. New parked_return_role(name) derives the role from the name (regex ^no-(.+)-return$, held to _fr.RETURN_ROLES) so a role added to RETURN_ROLES is covered with no second edit (drive-phase.py ~3148-3185); the drop test is role_return_filed(ctx, task, role) (the former already_filed body, generalised by role; already_filed(ctx, task) kept as the executor wrapper so submit's early look and its mutant hook are unchanged). The old 'decision != no-executor-return or already_filed is None' special case is gone. Phase-scoped no-phase-review-return has no task and is untouched (early return True; sign-off owns it). Tests in plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py, stage nr-block (_parked_return_cases, registered after wp-block): nr0 fixture parks; nr1 (the tests.add clause) single-task, reviewer decision pending then reviewer filed -> next closes the task (status done, commit set); nr2/nr3/nr3b wave: second member's decision parked behind the first's, kept while its return is missing (the twin against dropping blindly), dropped and the member closes once filed; nr4 every task role in RETURN_ROLES has its no-<role>-return name in the source and the rule names that role; nr5 enumerates every no-*-return string the drive source can emit (AST scan of drive-phase.py constants) and requires each to be a task role the rule handles or a PHASE_DECISIONS member, so a new role's name fails by name; nr6 ALLOW: shapes naming no RETURN_ROLES role read None. Description clauses: (1) same-shape reviewer sibling fixed - drive-phase.py parked_return_role/pending_still_applies; (2) F702 cause - covered by nr1/nr3b; (3) class not instance, one rule keyed by role - parked_return_role + role_return_filed; (4) a case per role - nr1/nr3b reviewer, existing wp1 executor; (5) one case asserting every emitted name is handled - nr5 (+nr4). Note: a wave's printed pending decision blocks re-checking of parked ones until it is answered (existing behaviour, left alone).
outcome.descriptive: A reviewer return filed after a no-reviewer-return decision was parked no longer reads as missing; one role-keyed rule now covers every parked no-<role>-return decision.

nr3 parked decision kept while return missing
nr3b parked wave decision dropped once filed
